title: Balancing scenario + contingency run
description: Set the operator's balancing plan against a declared contingency simulation, merge the results so disagreements surface, and loop until the plan holds under contingency.
yaml:
apiVersion: ladder.dev/v1alpha1
kind: Workflow
metadata:
  name: wf-enrg-02
  title: Balancing scenario + contingency run
  description: Set the operator's balancing plan against a declared contingency simulation, merge the
    results so disagreements surface, and loop until the plan holds under contingency.
  version: 1.0.0
spec:
  objective: Produce a balancing plan that has been tested against contingency simulation, with the binding
    constraint named and reserve adequacy demonstrated rather than asserted.
  policies:
    maxConcurrency: 4
    onFailure: preserve-completed
    requireApprovalFor:
      - n-approval
  nodes:
    - id: n-intake
      kind: input
      name: System state and forecast
      summary: System state and forecast
      inputSchema:
        type: object
        required:
          - text
        properties:
          text:
            type: string
            description: The requester's objective, source material, or instructions.
          workflowFields:
            type: object
            required:
              - load_forecast
              - generation_availability
              - interchange_schedule
              - reserve_requirement
            properties:
              load_forecast: {}
              generation_availability: {}
              interchange_schedule: {}
              reserve_requirement: {}
        x-ladder-input-mode: document
    - id: n-model
      kind: agent
      templateRef: enrg-02
      name: Operator balancing plan
      summary: Model-side estimate with stated assumptions.
      role: System operations analyst balancing load, generation, and reserve within security limits.
      prompt: You are a Grid Balancing Analyst. You balance forecast load against available generation,
        interchange, and reserve, and you test every proposed dispatch against contingency limits rather
        than against the base case alone. You state the binding constraint and the contingency it comes
        from, because 'the system is tight' is not an operating instruction.
      capabilities:
        skills:
          - domain-analysis
          - decision-analysis
          - teaching
          - risk-analysis
        tools:
          - read
          - calculate
        connectors:
          - mcp:scada
          - mcp:market-data
        permissions:
          - read-only
      outputSchema:
        type: object
    - id: n-run
      kind: tool
      name: Contingency simulation run
      summary: Host-supplied power-flow and contingency analysis. Declared as a requirement; Ladder Graph
        does not execute it.
      capabilities:
        skills:
          - decision-analysis
          - evaluation
        tools:
          - calculate
          - mcp:scada
        connectors: []
        permissions:
          - read-only
      outputSchema:
        type: object
    - id: n-compare
      kind: aggregator
      name: Merge estimate and instrument run
      summary: Merge the two result objects; every field where they disagree is surfaced as a collision
        rather than silently overwritten.
      config:
        aggregation: merge
    - id: n-fit
      kind: evaluate
      inlineRole: true
      name: Score agreement
      summary: Evaluate post-contingency limit violations, reserve adequacy, and flexibility availability.
      role: Deterministic metric evaluator
      prompt: Evaluate the upstream result against post-contingency limit violations, reserve adequacy,
        and flexibility availability. Return a score, pass/fail verdict, the evidence behind the verdict,
        remaining uncertainty, and the smallest corrective action. Do not claim programmatic measurement
        unless the host supplies the required tool.
      capabilities:
        skills:
          - evaluation
        tools:
          - read
          - calculate
        connectors: []
        permissions:
          - read-only
      outputSchema:
        type: object
        required:
          - score
          - passed
          - reasons
        properties:
          score:
            type: number
          passed:
            type: boolean
          reasons:
            type: array
            items:
              type: string
      config:
        threshold: 0.8
    - id: n-converged
      kind: condition
      name: Converged?
      summary: Route on fit.passed.
      config:
        expression: fit.passed
        branches:
          - label: Converged
            when: 'true'
          - label: Refine
            when: 'false'
    - id: n-refine
      kind: loop
      name: Refine assumptions until agreement
      summary: Repeat a bounded revision sequence until agreement between the estimate and the instrument
        run meets the declared threshold.
      config:
        body:
          - n-model
          - n-run
          - n-compare
          - n-fit
          - n-converged
        exitCondition: agreement between the estimate and the instrument run meets the declared threshold
        maxIterations: 4
        onExhausted: stop
    - id: n-approval
      kind: approval
      name: Shift supervisor approves the balancing plan
      summary: Pause for the shift supervisor; on timeout, escalate.
    - id: workflow-output
      kind: output
      name: Released deliverable
      summary: Return the completed Balancing scenario + contingency run deliverable, the evidence behind
        it, and every unresolved item.
  edges:
    - id: wf-enrg-02-edge-1
      from: n-intake
      to: n-model
      kind: data
    - id: wf-enrg-02-edge-2
      from: n-intake
      to: n-run
      kind: data
    - id: wf-enrg-02-edge-3
      from: n-model
      to: n-compare
      kind: data
    - id: wf-enrg-02-edge-4
      from: n-run
      to: n-compare
      kind: data
    - id: wf-enrg-02-edge-5
      from: n-compare
      to: n-fit
      kind: data
    - id: wf-enrg-02-edge-6
      from: n-fit
      to: n-converged
      kind: data
    - id: wf-enrg-02-edge-7
      from: n-converged
      to: n-approval
      kind: control
      condition: 'true'
    - id: wf-enrg-02-edge-8
      from: n-converged
      to: n-refine
      kind: control
      condition: 'false'
    - id: wf-enrg-02-edge-9
      from: n-refine
      to: n-approval
      kind: control
      condition: loop_exit
    - id: wf-enrg-02-edge-10
      from: n-approval
      to: workflow-output
      kind: dependency
      condition: approved
